title: Rebound of Retail and Hospitality Sectors since Start of 2022
what_it_is: Rebound of Retail and Hospitality Sectors since Start of 2022

sections.label: Retail and hotel recovery
sections.summary: Hotel room revenue rose four and a half times year-on-year in July 2022, and retail and hospitality recovered to 2019 levels.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Hotel room revenue in July 2022 was about $319 million and this is an increase of four and a half times year-on-year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: So, both sectors, the retail and the hospitality sectors, have recovered to comparable levels in 2019 before the COVID-19 pandemic, with retail sales even exceeding 2019 levels.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The recovery was bolstered by the healthy rebound in travel, with 1.5 million visitor arrivals in the first half of this year, which is nearly 12 times more than the same period in 2021.

sections.label: Refreshing Industry Transformation Maps
sections.summary: The 23 Industry Transformation Maps are being refreshed, with retail and hotel ITMs ensuring resilience of manpower, supply chains, operations and revenue streams.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The 23 Industry Transformation Maps (ITMs) are being refreshed and updated to incorporate insights gleaned from the pandemic and to address new challenges and also to seize opportunities arising from it.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Specifically, the retail and hotel ITMs will need to ensure that the sectors' manpower, supply chains, operations and revenue streams become more resilient against pandemics and other disruptions.

sections.label: Visitor arrivals and retail sales
sections.summary: STB projected four to six million visitor arrivals in 2022, hotel occupancy rose to about 79% in July, and retail sales averaged about $3.3 billion monthly.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: STB projected that we should welcome four to six million visitor arrivals for the whole year in 2022.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: This augurs well, not just for the retail and hospitality sectors, but also food services sector.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: And the average occupancy rate of hotels has risen to about 79% in July 2022 verses 58% a year ago.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: The total retail sales this year from January to July, over seven months, have averaged about $3.3 billion per month.
